theme: Classic Mr. Potato Head toy, colorful plastic pieces, bright primary colors

potatoBody.prompt: An isolated smooth brown potato body piece, standalone, no facial features, slightly oval, cartoon style, transparent background
potatoBody.rationale: The smooth brown potato body serves as the central character piece and fits perfectly with the playful theme.

drawer.prompt: An isolated wooden toy drawer piece, cartoon style, warm brown wood grain, slightly rounded edges, viewed from the front, transparent background
drawer.rationale: The drawer represents the storage for various parts, enhancing the playful interaction with Mr. Potato Head.

leftEye.prompt: An isolated cartoon googly left eye piece, round white with black pupil, plastic toy style, transparent background
leftEye.rationale: The googly eye adds character and fits the whimsical theme of the toy.

rightEye.prompt: An isolated cartoon googly right eye piece, round white with black pupil, plastic toy style, transparent background
rightEye.rationale: The second eye complements the first and maintains the playful character design.

nose.prompt: An isolated big orange carrot-shaped nose piece, cartoon plastic toy style, pointing forward, transparent background
nose.rationale: The carrot nose adds a fun and humorous element to the character's design.

mouth.prompt: An isolated wide red smiling mouth piece with white teeth, cartoon style, transparent background
mouth.rationale: The happy mouth enhances the joyful expression and overall character appeal.

mustache.prompt: An isolated thick black handlebar mustache piece, cartoon plastic toy style, curled ends, transparent background
mustache.rationale: The mustache adds a quirky and classic touch to Mr. Potato Head's face.

leftArm.prompt: An isolated small blue plastic left arm piece with open palm, cartoon toy style, waving gesture, transparent background
leftArm.rationale: The left arm piece emphasizes playfulness and dynamic interaction.

rightArm.prompt: An isolated small blue plastic right arm piece with open palm, cartoon toy style, waving gesture, transparent background
rightArm.rationale: The right arm piece complements the left and enhances the character's playful demeanor.

hat.prompt: An isolated small black bowler hat piece, classic style, plastic toy, cartoon, shiny, transparent background
hat.rationale: The bowler hat adds a distinctive and stylish character to Mr. Potato Head.

ears.prompt: An isolated pair of large pink plastic ears piece, attached by headband, cartoon toy style, transparent background
ears.rationale: The ears add to the playful nature and complete the character's look.
